findings.problem: Preview text still promises reconciliation "that never makes a mistake". That is a zero-errors claim, which brand/voice.md forbids (claim 4 and the "Words we avoid" table: no 100% accurate or zero errors). It also uses pushy "last chance" pressure, which the brand avoids.
findings.fix: Preview: Automated bank reconciliation, with exceptions reported for your team to review.

findings.problem: The body still has a second link (https://ledgerflow.example/features). Rule 3 in .claude/rules/emails.md allows exactly one main link, the subscribe link, and no other links in the body. A "full feature list" could also present unfinished features as ready to use (claim 8).
findings.fix: Delete line 14 so the body has only the [Sign up now](https://ledgerflow.example/subscribe) link.

findings.problem: "Last chance! Prices go up at midnight, so sign up now or miss out for good." is still pushy, fear-based sales language, which brand/voice.md says to avoid. Nothing backs up the midnight price deadline, so it may mislead readers.
findings.fix: If you'd like to see how it fits your workflow, join the waitlist below. Your team stays in control.

findings.problem: The "100% accurate" claim is gone, but the subject still opens with "Last chance:". That is the pushy urgency brand/voice.md says to avoid, and no real deadline backs it up.
findings.fix: Subject: Faster reconciliation your team can review
